description: Isolated query profiling, AST N+1 bottleneck detection, and mock-data sandbox engine for Django & DRF.
single_source_of_truth_rules: Core logic in `dqs/core/` MUST be pure Python and framework-agnostic. No Django/DRF imports allowed in `dqs/core/`.
DB profiling MUST run inside `transaction.atomic()` savepoints with mandatory rollback to preserve DB integrity.
Static AST code scanning must inspect user code without importing or executing target modules.
When modifying functions or class signatures, agents MUST check and update all call sites across `dqs/` and `tests/`.

dqs/core/analyzer.py.key_logic: Uses `sqlglot` to parse SQL AST, strips literals, canonicalizes table aliases to T0/T1, collapses IN lists, groups queries by fingerprint+location, flags N+1, and suggests `.select_related()` / `.prefetch_related()`.

dqs/core/static_advisor.py.key_logic: Parses Python AST with standard library `ast`. Detects ORM queries inside `For`/`While` loops and blocking synchronous callables (`requests.get`, `smtplib`, `time.sleep`).

adapters_drf.purpose: Django & Django REST Framework integration layer

dqs/adapters/drf/discovery.py.key_logic: Aggregates HTTP view routes, post_save/pre_save signals, and Celery tasks into unified `Target` objects.

dqs/adapters/drf/introspector.py.key_logic: Recursively traverses `urlpatterns`, extracts view classes/functions, maps HTTP methods, and inspects parameters.

dqs/adapters/drf/query_interceptor.py.key_logic: Context manager wrapping `connection.execute_wrapper()`. Captures SQL, duration, and walks `inspect.stack()` to map queries to exact app file line numbers.

dqs/adapters/drf/runner.py.key_logic: Triggers targets via DRF `APIRequestFactory` inside `transaction.atomic()` savepoints and issues automatic savepoint rollbacks.

dqs/adapters/drf/schema_advisor.py.key_logic: Analyzes captured SQL filter clauses to recommend DB indexes for high-frequency unindexed columns.

dqs/adapters/drf/converters.py.key_logic: Converts DRF serializer schemas and view parameters into mock payload generators.

commands.unit_core: pytest -m core (Fast framework-agnostic AST logic tests)
commands.integration_django: pytest -m django (Django DB savepoint and runner tests)
